"""Self-contained MVCE for xarray #7229 (no network needed).

Mirrors the issue: ds.air has variable attrs, ds.time has coord attrs;
xr.where(True, ds.air, ds.air, keep_attrs=True) must keep the COORD attrs.
"""
import numpy as np
if not hasattr(np, "unicode_"):
    np.unicode_ = np.str_  # numpy-2 shim for this old checkout
if not hasattr(np, "float_"):
    np.float_ = np.float64
if not hasattr(np, "int_"):
    np.int_ = np.int64

import sys
import xarray as xr

VAR_ATTRS = {
    "long_name": "4xDaily Air temperature at sigma level 995",
    "units": "degK",
    "precision": 2,
}
COORD_ATTRS = {"standard_name": "time", "long_name": "Time"}

ds = xr.Dataset(
    {"air": (("time",), np.arange(10.0), VAR_ATTRS)},
    coords={"time": ("time", np.arange(10), COORD_ATTRS)},
)

res = xr.where(True, ds.air, ds.air, keep_attrs=True)
got = dict(res.time.attrs)
print("coord attrs BEFORE:", dict(ds.time.attrs))
print("coord attrs AFTER :", got)

ok_coord = got == COORD_ATTRS
ok_var = dict(res.attrs) == VAR_ATTRS
print("data-var attrs kept:", ok_var, dict(res.attrs))

# regression guard from test_where_attrs: DataArray-level keep_attrs
cond = xr.DataArray([True, False], dims="x", attrs={"attr": "cond"})
x = xr.DataArray([1, 1], dims="x", attrs={"attr": "x"})
y = xr.DataArray([0, 0], dims="x", attrs={"attr": "y"})
actual = xr.where(cond, x, y, keep_attrs=True)
ok_da = dict(actual.attrs) == {"attr": "x"}
print("DataArray attrs kept:", ok_da, dict(actual.attrs))

# scalar x/y with keep_attrs=True must not crash
scalar_ok = True
try:
    r2 = xr.where(cond, 1, 0, keep_attrs=True)
    scalar_ok = r2.attrs == {}
except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
    scalar_ok = False
    print("scalar case FAILED:", type(e).__name__, e)
print("scalar x/y ok:", scalar_ok)

sys.exit(0 if (ok_coord and ok_var and ok_da and scalar_ok) else 1)
